metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Adolescence
metas.description: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, therapist and the detective in charge are all left asking what really happened.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Dept. Q
metas.description: Carl, a former top-rated detective, is wracked with guilt following an attack that left his partner paralyzed and another policeman dead. On his return to work, Carl is assigned to a cold case that will consume his life.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · His & Hers
metas.description: A journalist investigating a murder in her hometown clashes with a suspicious detective. There are two sides to every story, and someone is lying.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · The Beast in Me
metas.description: Author Aggie Wiggs, grieving the loss of her son, finds new purpose unraveling the mystery behind neighbor Nile Jarvis' vanished wife and his suspicious dealings.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · I Will Find You
metas.description: A father imprisoned for his son's murder receives evidence suggesting his child may be alive, compelling him to escape and uncover the truth.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · The Residence
metas.description: Inside the White House's staff residence and the lives which workers share with the First Family.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · Black Rabbit
metas.description: When the owner of a New York City hotspot allows his turbulent brother back in his life, he opens the door to escalating dangers that threaten to bring down everything he's built.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Legends
metas.description: Customs agents go undercover to infiltrate Britain's most dangerous drug gangs, following a thrilling criminal investigation based on extensive research and interviews with those involved in the top-secret operation.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Agatha Christie's Seven Dials
metas.description: In 1925, a country house party prank turns deadly. Lady Eileen "Bundle" Brent investigates the chilling murder plot. Lady Caterham and Superintendent Battle assist in solving the country house mystery that changes Bundle's life.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Run Away
metas.description: Simon's perfect life is shattered when daughter Paige runs away, later found strung out in a park. Simon's search leads into a dangerous underworld where an act of violence rocks his life.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Detective Hole
metas.description: A brilliant but troubled detective, Harry Hole, hunts a serial killer while battling a corrupt adversary, Tom Waaler, as they navigate ethical gray areas, with Harry determined to bring the criminal to justice.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2025 · Missing You
metas.description: Detective Kat Donovan's world unravels when she finds her estranged fiancé on a dating app. Leading her to reopen her father's unsolved murder.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · The Waterfront
metas.description: As their storied North Carolina fishing empire decays, the damaged Buckleys grapple to revive their imperiled maritime heritage.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Apple Cider Vinegar
metas.description: The life of wellness guru Belle Gibson, who had a large social media following, where she pretended to be suffering from cancer but keeping the disease under control using self-care therapies. She confessed that none of it was true.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · The Åre Murders
metas.description: A Stockholm detective under internal investigation heads to a ski resort to unwind, until a young girl's disappearance compels her back to work.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Man on Fire
metas.description: Follows John Creasy, a wounded former mercenary on a quest to get revenge for the loss of his only companion while defending the daughter of his dead colleague from the forces that tore her family apart.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · The Breakthrough
metas.description: When the double murder in Linköping, Sweden, back in 2004 was finally solved after 16 years, it was a genealogist who made the breakthrough. For the first time in Europe, a murder could be solved through genealogical research.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · The Glass Dome
metas.description: A criminologist and her former police chief partner investigate the vanishing of a local girl in the small Swedish town where she was once held captive.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Mercy for None
metas.description: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death, embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
metas.description: Berlin reunites his crew in Seville for an elaborate con targeting a powerful duke and his wife who've made the mistake of trying to blackmail him. Their plan involves faking the theft of a priceless painting as cover.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2025 · Billionaires' Bunker
metas.description: When World War III is about to break out, a group of billionaires takes refuge in a luxury bunker. Through screens, they watch the spectacle of the world they knew collapsing above their heads.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Unfamiliar
metas.description: Ex-spies Simon and Meret operate a Berlin safe house until a past threat resurfaces. Now they're fleeing hitmen, Russian agents, BND, ex-lovers, and old enemies while trying to save their marriage.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2025 · The Survivors
metas.description: Fifteen years ago, a storm devastated the coastal town of Evelyn Bay and took three young people: Kieran's older brother, Finn, Mia's best friend, Gabby, and Finn's friend, Toby. Burdened by guilt, Kieran and Mia escaped.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · The Asset
metas.description: Agent Tea infiltrates a criminal gang, befriending Ashley, the girlfriend of ringleader Miran. Witnessing Ashley's stark reality, Tea is torn between her mission and a desire to help her escape Miran's control.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2025 · Black Warrant
metas.description: A newly appointed jailer at Tihar Prison confronts widespread corruption and injustice within its walls, forcing him to choose between maintaining the status quo or fighting for reform.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Karma
metas.description: Bound by their harrowing destinies, a physician plagued by nightmares, a man shaken after his world was unexpectedly disrupted and a debtor drowning in private loans become caught in inescapable circumstances.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · Amy Bradley Is Missing
metas.description: March 24, 1998, Amy Lynn Bradley, 23, is enjoying a family cruise vacation when Amy suddenly vanishes without a trace. This twist-filled 3-part documentary mystery explores the theories, and a family's desperate search for the truth.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2025 · The Monster of Florence
metas.description: As a serial killer strikes terror in Italy by targeting couples parked in lovers lanes, authorities explore a case from 1968 that may be key to identifying The Monster of Florence.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web
metas.description: At customs, Superintendent Meena's elite team faces a crucial mission: stop rising contraband trafficking and take down global crime boss Bada Choudhary's syndicate.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Blood Sacrifice
metas.description: A Stockholm detective must team up with his estranged ex-cop father to catch a serial killer targeting police officers, forcing them to resolve their differences during the investigation.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · Trigger
metas.description: About two men who are trying to solve a mess after firearms are suddenly widely available in South Korea, which used to be a gun-free country, through an unknown source.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2025 · Bet
metas.description: A transfer student from Japan disrupts a boarding school's power structure with her gambling skills, challenging the Student Council while pursuing revenge that could overturn the entire system.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Gone Girls: The Long Island Serial Killer
metas.description: A look back at the women who disappeared from New York City and Long Island before the 2010 discovery of female remains found in the Gilgo Beach area of Long Island, which lead authorities to believe the deaths were all connected.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Khakee: The Bengal Chapter
metas.description: When upright cop Arjun Maitra takes on Kolkata's feared don Bagha and his henchmen, he must battle a broken system and navigate bloody gang wars.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · The Art of Sarah
metas.description: A Korean-American woman's ambition leads her to create a fake luxury brand, targeting the wealthy elite. As she navigates the world of high-end fashion and deception, her scheme unfolds in this gripping crime mystery drama.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2026 · Nemesis
metas.description: LA crime drama pits master thief Coltrane Wilder against detective Isaiah Stiles, challenging heist genre norms while examining what drives, sustains and destroys people.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · The Price of Confession
metas.description: A woman accused of killing her husband is offered a deal by a mysterious stranger - but to prove her innocence, she must commit murder.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · The Witness
metas.description: New resident witnesses a crime in his apartment complex but stays silent when police seek an eyewitness. His choice allows the crime to go unsolved, leading to escalating danger.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2025 · Caught
metas.description: In Bariloche, reporter Ema Garay's online exposes unveil tax dodgers. Her probe into a 16-year-old's disappearance points to Leo Mercer, upending both their lives.
